audience: salons, spas and other appointment-based businesses who take bookings with AgendaPro

useCases.title: List the bookings of a location for a day
useCases.text: Lists bookings with time, status, service, provider and price, and opens one booking with its notes and linked sale.

useCases.title: Find open booking slots
useCases.text: Lists the open time windows at a location on one date, optionally for one service or provider, with start, end and provider.

useCases.title: Find a client and their bookings
useCases.text: Searches clients by name, email, phone or identification number, opens the client, and lists that client's bookings.

useCases.title: Review sales and what is still unpaid
useCases.text: Lists sales with status (paid, partially paid, canceled, refunded), paid and pending amounts and payments, and opens one sale.

useCases.title: Book an appointment for a client
useCases.text: Checks the open slots, then creates a booking for an existing client, service, provider and location.

useCases.title: Move, change or cancel a booking
useCases.text: Changes a booking's time, service, provider, location or status, or cancels it. A cancellation cannot be undone through the API.
